notes:
BDR Setup Loader 1.0.10

New in this version:
- One Apply button. Apply puts the setup in the game and saves it as a preset in your game's tune list right away, no restart needed. The preset name is copied to your clipboard.
- New, smaller plugin that only reads your active car and applies setups. Close the game before you update.
- Search matches every word you type. Try "pro mod turbo" or "camaro converter".
- Class pages have a filter box and a "Best per car" switch that keeps only the quickest setup for each car.
- Browse by Car: every car with its setup count, class count, fastest ET and top speed. Click a car to see all its setups in every class.
- Compare: put two setups side by side, with ET, trap speed, 60ft, 330ft, 1/8 mile, wins, ET spread, shift light, weight and every setting that differs.
- Tune details show validation passes and ET spread, the chassis and engine profile, and a gear ratio and shift point table.
- Copy Web Link and Copy Discord Summary share a setup. Copy Compare Link shares a comparison.
- Removed: the in-game F9 list and taking car photos in the game. Car photos come with the tunes.
